name: 3D Fast Bilateral Solver
definition: A 3D extension to the Fast Bilateral Solver [12] used to refine annotated similarity volumes. It increases the resolution of similarity maps and adapts them to the underlying intensity volume to improve visual quality.
summary: The 3D Fast Bilateral Solver is a post-processing technique that upsamples low-resolution similarity maps to high resolution while adapting them to the edges of an underlying raw intensity volume.
